title: policy.json: release
description: Release packages (design part 16.5, HITLD-752): each package has its own version, tags, release records and interface delta. Every repository declares at least one; `hitld install` declares the first, and `hitld release migrate` moves a repository's earlier, repository-wide releases into a package named main. `hitld work check` refuses tag templates that could match the same tag, a dependency on a package that is not declared, and dependency cycles.

packages.description: The release packages. `release propose` and `release make` take --package, which may be left out only when exactly one is declared.

name.description: The package's name: lower-case letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. Its records are under <work dir>/releases/<name>/.

tag.description: The tag template (default {name}@{version}): letters, digits and . _ - @ /, with {name} at most once and {version} once, at the end. Other shapes: {name}-v{version}, {name}/v{version}, v{version}.

paths.description: The paths the package owns, as globs (* within a segment, ** across segments). An item belongs to every package whose paths hold a file it touches; when several packages' globs match one file, the most specific glob wins.

surface.description: The committed surface file the project's own tool writes: one line per public interface element. `release propose` diffs it between the last full release and now: lines only added propose minor, a removed or changed line proposes major (minor while 0.y.z), no change proposes patch. With none, the interface is not measured and patch is proposed.

version_source.description: A JSON file whose `version` key holds the package's version, such as package.json; `release propose` warns when it differs from the proposed version.

depends_on.description: Other packages this one is built against, each with a version range: an exact version, ^x.y.z, ~x.y.z, a comparison (>=, >, <=, <) or several joined by spaces, or *. A release record pins the exact version of each.

group.description: A lockstep group: every package in it shares one version and is released together.

channels.description: The pre-release channels `--pre` may name (default alpha, beta and rc). Each channel keeps its own counter per package and version.
